dates.title: La Possession de Loudun — selected and presented historical texts
dates.basis: Julliard, 1970. De Certeau is credited as scientific editor and presenter, not author of every historical document.

dates.title: L’écriture de l’histoire
dates.basis: French original, 1975; later translations remain distinct.

dates.title: L’invention du quotidien, 1: Arts de faire
dates.basis: French original, 1980. The companion volume 2, Habiter, cuisiner, is by Luce Giard and Pierre Mayol, as the English preface at ix explains.

dates.title: The Practice of Everyday Life — Steven Rendall’s English translation
dates.basis: The English preface is dated 26 February 1984. This translation of Arts de faire is distinct from the 1980 French original.

relationship_scope.claim: Situated ways of operating become objects of historical and cultural inquiry
relationship_scope.evidence: English preface ix and General Introduction xi–xii examine relational practices and refuse an atomistic model of the user; this is a bounded methodological contribution.

relationship_scope.claim: Cultural consumption can transform the uses of imposed representations
relationship_scope.evidence: General Introduction xii–xiv distinguishes representations and purchase/attendance statistics from what users make with cultural products. This does not establish that every consumer resists power.

relationship_scope.claim: Questions an account of discipline centred on the apparatus that produces it
relationship_scope.evidence: General Introduction xiv–xv directly discusses Discipline and Punish and asks how users appropriate or evade disciplinary arrangements. This specific criticism preserves the acknowledged analytical debt.
